Poe => bash scripts/create_secrets.sh
Creating /workspace/.env
These values are shared local secrets. Keep .env ignored and private.
If you regenerate this file later, wipe Docker volumes before restarting the stack.




Created /workspace/.env
exit=0

# Browser-facing base URLs. Localhost by default, or https://<port>-$WEB_HOST behind
# a reverse proxy. Consumed by docker-compose.yaml (Keycloak hostname + oauth2-proxy) and
# process-compose.yaml (frontend). Regenerate .env after switching between plain-localhost and reverse-proxy setups.
FRONTEND_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:3000
KEYCLOAK_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:9090

TEMPORAL_UI_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:8233

LOCAL_USER_PASSWORD=SparkLocal123!

DOCLING_HOST=localhost
DOCLING_PORT=5001
DOCLING_BASE_URL=http://localhost:5001
DOCLING_OCR_ENGINE=rapidocr
DOCLING_TIMEOUT=600

observation.command:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd /workspace && printf '%s\n' \
  'spark@example.com' \
  'SparkLocal123!' \
  'Spark' \
  'User' \
  'http://localhost:4000' \
  'sk-local-key' \
  'gpt-4o-mini' \
  'text-embedding-3-small' \
  'gpt-4o-mini' \
  'http' \
  'localhost' \
  '5001' \
  'rapidocr' \
  '' \
  '' \
  '' | uv run poe create-secrets 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[1]}"; echo "--- .env ---"; ls -la .env && cat .env
